nodes.name: Patient-11
nodes.summary:
Patient-11 (born October 16, 1971, case number URO-2026-0011) was referred by Dr. med. Arzt-11 on November 6, 2026, to the Urologische Klinik at Klinikum Bremen due to an elevated PSA value of 6.3 ng/ml and working diagnosis of C61 Prostatakarzinom. Laboratory testing on November 12, 2026, confirmed an elevated total PSA of 6.3 ng/ml. On December 9, 2026, Patient-11 underwent a prostate MRI at the Institut für Diagnostische Radiologie, Klinikum Stuttgart – Klinik-12, yielding a PI-RADS Score of 3 and suspicion of prostate cancer. On December 30, 2026, a transrectal prostate core biopsy (12 cores, 1-3 positive) at the Institut für Pathologie, Klinikum Bremen – Klinik-11, confirmed Adenokarzinom der Prostata with a Gleason-Score of 3+3=6 (ISUP 1), pre-operative PSA 6.4 ng/ml. On January 11, 2027, an interdisciplinary tumor board conference protocol chaired by Dr. med. Arzt-11 staged the cancer as cT1c cN0 cM0, EAU low-risk, with a PSA of 6.4 ng/ml, recommending active surveillance.
Patient Patient-11 is undergoing active surveillance as part of the treatment plan for prostate cancer.
Patient Patient-11 has a total PSA value of 7.0 ng/ml.

nodes.name: Prostatakarzinom
nodes.summary:

The condition is managed under active surveillance with regular PSA monitoring, showing stable clinical courses and gradually increasing PSA levels reaching 6.8 ng/ml by February 24, 2028.
Patient-11 has a documented diagnosis of C61 Prostatakarzinom and is undergoing active surveillance for low-risk disease.
Patient-11 has a clinical diagnosis of C61 Prostatakarzinom on July 24, 2028.
